sb21398df030292: What does this re-program mean for the Hami community?
sc272f6e844c933: If it's just a pageshot, this update looks like "the official network is getting better." But from the perspective of community-building, it's even deeper.
s9e5e3bb13f37d2: First, Hami's external expression is becoming more systematic.
s6d0afed55c9783: Instead of being a scattered collection of pages, the network is developing a complete narrative chain: users can understand project values from the front page, understand capacity details from documents, understand practice paths from blogs and understand impact from community and ecological modules.
sdc0469e142b8d7: Second, community content assets have been reorganized.
sb9cbc4cb16b738: Many valuable articles, graphics and descriptions of the past may exist but are not easily visible. These elements are now more effectively linked through the home page section, navigation and search re-engineering.
sdf238699d934e2: Thirdly, Hami's community is more mature.
s8ef71d12e137f3: A mature open-source project, not only for code warehouse activity but also for clear, stable and sustainable official network expression. The structure, style and ease of use of the website is itself part of community engineering capacity.
s1743e1cd2df7d6: Fourth, it provides the basis for a follow-up process of expanding cases, users, contributors and ecological content.
sf17c26730a3560: When the basic framework is streamlined, it will be more natural and understandable to users in the future, whether by adding more case studies, complementing community collaboration portals or showing more adopters and eco-partners.
sd8651aaf595f5c: As a community contributor, I value the three points of this adaptation.
s9da3e8ef896e61: If I sum up in one sentence, I would think that this remodel really did the right three things:
s114f3a297e062b: Upgrading the network from "the contents stack" to "the community entrance".
s4d3df6bd5d04f2: The visual optimization and information architecture are adjusted together, rather than just skin change.
sf050af5d3240d7: The basic experience of searching, moving end, navigation and footers is complemented.
s8819db3821ff68: These things sound less visible than a new feature, but they have a direct impact on community content dissemination, user understanding of costs and long-term project images.
s06d37a3c11cb98: For infrastructure projects such as HAMi, technological capacity is of course fundamental, but it is also an infrastructure that makes it clear, well organized and continuous.
s1044a2522003cb: This round of HAMi documentation and network re-engineering is essentially the infrastructure to complement community expression.
sd05afc2335b362: It has raised the visual and reading experience on the one hand, and re-engineered content organization, front page narratives, search paths, mobile access, and community signal displays on the other. The first page is redesigned, structured drawings are redrawn, blog styles are unified, mobile end optimization is enhanced, Fouter is enhanced, and a return to internal searches from outside is built together, which constitutes this "restructuring" in the true sense of the term.
s50e5a7949cd518: Externally, it allows more people to understand HAMi more quickly; internally, it also provides communities with a stronger vehicle for follow-up of sedimentation cases, ecological expansion, service users and contributors.
s4568cd48274c19: The official network is not a subsidiary of the open-source community, but part of the long-term influence of the community. This time, Hami is working on it.
